page_title: INT 5-1 ACM | Inter v AC Milan 16/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' The referee Simone Sozza awards Davide Frattesi (Inter) a yellow card.
90+3' 5 - 1 Davide Frattesi (Inter) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
90+2' 40:60 – the ratio of ball possession.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. Inter will take a free kick near the side line.
89' AC Milan keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
86' Stefano Pioli prepares a substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek is replaced by Yunus Musah (AC Milan).
85' A cross from a corner kick by Inter is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
84' One of the AC Milan players was holding his opponent and the referee doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Kristjan Asllani (Inter) is brought on as a substitute for Hakan Calhanoglu.
79' 4 - 1 Goal! Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mike Maignan into middle of the goal.
79' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is going to take the penalty!
79' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) brings an opponent down and Simone Sozza interrupts the game. PENALTY to Inter! Great chance to score.
77' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Tijjani Reijnders and he is replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
77' Substitution. Noah Okafor (AC Milan) replaces Olivier Giroud.
77' Substitution. Davide Calabria is replaced by Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Stefan de Vrij (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Alessandro Bastoni.
72' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
69' 3 - 1 Goal! Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Mike Maignan. He makes it 3:1.

66' Carlos Augusto (Inter) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the left post. Mike Maignan has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
64' Substitution. Marcus Thuram makes way for Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
64' It is time for a substitution. Carlos Augusto (Inter) is on for Federico Dimarco.
63' Simone Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Davide Frattesi (Inter) replacing Nicolo Barella.
61' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.
57' 2 - 1 Rafael Leao (AC Milan) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
56' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Christian Pulisic as he is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).

56' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.

55' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
53' A lofted cross from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
53' AC Milan players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
51' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
49' Half-chance! Rafael Leao (AC Milan) plays a pass into the box, but Yann Sommer reacts well to snuff out the attack.
46' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.

45+1' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Simone Sozza blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. AC Milan earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
44' It looks like Denzel Dumfries (Inter) saw red with that tackle. Simone Sozza won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. AC Milan earn a free kick.
43' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
41' Inter are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.

38' 2 - 0 Goal! That was a fantastic finish by Marcus Thuram (Inter) from just outside the box. He wasted little time in getting away a bullet of a shot that flew past the goalkeeper into the top right corner of the net.
36' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
35' 6:1 – the total goal attempt statistics.
32' A great run from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
30' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
30' A free kick from far out for AC Milan. We are about to see the outcome very soon.
26' Federico Dimarco (Inter) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
24' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
20' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to AC Milan.
20' Inter quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

20' Francesco Acerbi (Inter) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' None of the Inter players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
14' A spell of possession for Inter in an attempt to control the game.
11' The corner is swung in but Inter can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
7' Referee Simone Sozza points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) goes wild in celebration.
6' The Inter players halt their celebrations as referee Simone Sozza makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
5' 1 - 0 Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) reacts quickly in the penalty area and scores with aplomb, giving the goalkeeper no chance!
5' The AC Milan players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Inter will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Simone Sozza.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
